div.span: The client sends a JSON-RPC POST with a Bearer token. The CloudFront-scope web ACL runs before anything else: IP reputation, rate limits per IP, per initialize and per tool, Bot Control labels, body size, protocol version, tool allowlist, and SSRF, destructive SQL, SQLi and XSS in tool arguments.

div.b: VPC origin to a private ALB

div.span: The ALB has only private IPs; its security group admits port 80 from the CloudFront origin-facing prefix list. CloudFront adds the secret x-origin-verify header on every origin request.

div.b: Regional AWS WAF on the ALB

div.span: Default block. Allows only requests with the secret header and an mcp/ scope in x-jwt-claims, and repeats the tool-argument rules, so a workload inside the VPC cannot skip the edge checks.

div.span: Isolated subnets. The task pulls its image from Amazon ECR, writes logs and fetches the JWKS through interface and gateway VPC endpoints over AWS PrivateLink.
